x: Charlie Speechley, our evergreen at sixty-five years of age, again showed he can still show the youngsters how. We were glad to see W. Emery with us again and hope to see more of him, and L.

We were pleased to welcome Wally Emery once again from Eastleigh. He's certainly got some weight to get rid of before he is fit and we look forward to seeing him more regularly now he has finished his National Service.

August Bank Holiday 6th August proved a good day for our walkers when two teams entered the open 6 miles race at Chertsey which starts and finishes on the track. We were pleased to see Nick Milsum home on leave and Wally Emery who has started again. We look forward to seeing him during the winter.

Wally Emery put a Belgrave vest in front early on, but unfortunately split his heel and had to retire. Belgrave men, it seemed, were everywhere, and if all had been eligible to score we would have won the team event; as it was we missed third place by one point and were only eight points behind Metr…

Our thanks are due to Wally Emery for laying on transport for our lone supporter and to that supporter for sustaining Stan with boiled sweets on the return journey-we always thought he was a bit of a sucker!
